title: Mack Superliner Powder Coated High Tensile Road Train Bullbar #25
description: Mack Superliner FUPS compliant hi-tensile powder coated aluminium Bullbar, 88mm dia. pipe, 100mm dia. available. Indicator and daytime running lights in outer uprights, reversible aluminium Road Train-Long Vehicle signs with covers. Main uprights extend to the bottom of the main bar. Cowcatcher and 4 small uprights. Tow pin mounted in heavy duty high tensile aluminium backing plate with steel tow plate protector. Powder Coated colours from colour chart range to your choice.
